Home.title: Ship the product, not the plumbing.
Home.description: A complete frontend foundation: typed API calls, accessible UI, localization, testing and observability. Explore it all in a working Projects demo.
Home.highlightTyped: Typed contracts from form to API
Home.codePreviewLabel: Example of the typed API boundary
Home.codePreviewCaption: Every response is validated at runtime before it reaches the UI.
Home.stackLabel: Built on tools you already know
Home.stackDescription: Build on a working app instead of assembling its UI, data layer and quality checks from scratch. Every part is yours to adapt.
Home.designDescription: Tailwind CSS and editable shadcn/ui primitives, with light/dark themes, Lucide icons and generated SVG components.
Home.i18nDescription: English and Bosnian routes, typed messages, a language switcher and locale-aware dates and numbers.
Home.formsDescription: React Hook Form and Zod validation pair with a reusable TanStack Table for sorting and data states.
Home.accessibilityDescription: Skip navigation, labelled controls, dialogs and reusable loading, empty, error and retry states.
Home.apiDescription: Axios requests with path and query parameters, cancellation, Zod response validation and normalized errors.
Home.authDescription: Connect a bearer-token or cookie provider with coordinated session refresh and unauthorized handling.
Home.clientDescription: TanStack Query keys, invalidation, optimistic updates with rollback and localized error toasts.
Home.mocksDescription: MSW serves the full Projects API locally, including CRUD, search, sorting, pagination and summaries.
Home.metadataDescription: Canonical and language-alternate URLs, social previews, sitemap, robots rules and a web manifest.
Home.observabilityDescription: Route and global error boundaries, reporting hooks with metadata redaction, and a pluggable Web Vitals reporter.
Home.performanceDescription: Lighthouse budgets, bundle analysis, CSP and hardened response headers are ready to run.
Home.qualityDescription: Vitest, Playwright, accessibility and visual suites, Storybook, CI, dependency audits and Git hooks.
Home.demoDescription: Projects is a complete CRUD interface built on the starter's typed REST contract. The browser mock makes it usable from the first run.
Home.demoScope: Bring your own backend, database and identity provider when you're ready to go live.
Home.demoOverviewDescription: Summary cards show total, recent and documented projects.
Home.demoFormsDescription: Create and edit with shared schemas, localized errors and pending feedback.
Home.demoBrowseDescription: Search, sort and page through projects with typed URL state from nuqs.
Home.demoMutationsDescription: Optimistic edits and deletes roll back if the request fails.
Home.workflowTitle: From clone to product UI in three commands
Home.workflowDescription: Node.js 24 and pnpm 11 are the only requirements.
Home.stepInstallDescription: Use the pinned package manager and lockfile to install the project dependencies.
Home.stepSetupDescription: Set the app identity, public origins, default locale and localized descriptions.
Home.stepDevDescription: Mocks are enabled by default, so the Projects demo runs without a backend.
Home.ctaTitle: Clone it. Rename it. Start on the product.
Home.ctaDescription: Start with a working Projects demo, then connect your own API and turn the starter into your product.
Home.footerNote: Built with Next.js, React and Tailwind CSS.
